name: ar-carousel-v1
about: Part 1 article recording (cap-worst, lead 2026-10-10, user T-170 #151 and T-211 #7): the 'hero carousel' = the user carousel, the small profile photos in the community pill of #people (.start-selling-avatars.is-carousel, 104x32 px, doc y ~2050, changes about every 1.03 s; research/article-clips/README.md). Reload, 2 s, robot drags up to put the pill in view (people-v1's carousel drags, from the top: 520, 520, 520 px in 2000 ms each and 200 px in 1000 ms, 'drag' profile, 250 ms apart; ~1,760 px, so the pill sits in the upper half of the view), settle, mark rest, 12 s still (~11 changes), mark end. Same input on both arms; fixed before any capture (swapped from the top-of-page version before it ran).
